craft_notes: Sthāyin: order-joy. Close: pursuit. Rejected: 'box' — killed: casket kept; 'reverence' flat — worship kept.

lines: There let the hero worship forthgoing, then the seat anew;
casketed, let him the worship-practice pursue.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra sṛṣṭiṃ yajed vīraḥ punar evāsanaṃ tataḥ | sṛṣṭiṃ tu sampuṭīkṛtya paścād yajanam ārabhet

reads_against.argmap: There the hero worships emanation, then the seat; casketed, worship begins.
c1_essence: Hero worships emanation, then seat; casketed, begin.
